contract.provides: For an arbitrary matroid on n elements accessed by an independence oracle, rational A∈Q^{m×n} with squared Euclidean column norms at most one, rational x in its base polytope, and rational objective c, the source claims a deterministic polynomial-bit algorithm returning a basis B with cᵀ1_B≤cᵀx and ||A(1_B−x)||∞≤262336. For fixed A,x, an ellipsoid metarounding step is claimed to construct at most n+1 bases with rational probabilities, exact mean x, and the same discrepancy bound at every support point. The algorithmic claim is specific to matroid bases; it does not promote the broader N689 Boolean-polytope existence classification to an algorithm.
requires: Arbitrary matroid by independence oracle; rational unit-Euclidean-column-normalized matrix and rational base-polytope point. The response claims a polynomial-bit basis with a nonincreasing rational objective and discrepancy at most 262336.
